titleHistory.title: Horror Games Stacked Like Cordwood! (Bring Your Own Hazmat Suit...)

games.description: Three solo visits to the haunted house at Dread Pit Road. Sark first struggles with the investigation system, returns after studying the evidence mechanics, and follows the wartime story into the desert ruins. The final visit stops at the bell and dagger search.
games.title: Incubus: A ghost-hunters tale

games.description: Fishing on a deserted island leads Sark into an impossible burger restaurant. The search for seven seals, Petrovsky’s revelations and a makeshift weapon build toward Tyler’s escape and the final kaiju confrontation.
games.title: Manny's

games.description: Sark follows a mission through bones, forest and caves in an Iron Lung-inspired horror game. The run ends after he becomes stuck in a narrow cave opening.
games.title: Metal Casket

games.description: Sark pilots the submarine, uses sonar and a scanner to investigate the wreck, and tests precise artifact coordinates. Unresponsive collection controls end the dive unfinished.
games.title: Ocean Pressure

games.description: Sark investigates a haunted property through a realtor’s camera, photographing apparitions and checking the VHS clues. Crashes and a disappearing enemy eventually undermine the investigation.
games.title: Samira's House
